purpose.How this workbook should be used: One place to track tasks, projects, delays, risks, approvals, actions and KPIs.
purpose.Rule: If it is not written, it did not happen.
purpose.Notes: Designed for Google Sheets shared-drive use.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Every task must have one owner, due date, status, next action and evidence when applicable.
purpose.Rule: No task should belong to the team.
purpose.Notes: Chairman / CEO can also be owner of approvals.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Use Export-NXP Checklist for NXP, SGS, phytosanitary, fumigation, certificate of origin, invoice, packing list, B/L and buyer documents.
purpose.Rule: Documents run in parallel with sourcing.
purpose.Notes: Do not wait until goods are ready before starting documents.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Record every delay, including executive decisions, unsigned documents, pending funding, supplier issues and transport problems.
purpose.Rule: Bad news must move faster than the goods.
purpose.Notes: A delay is managed only when it has owner/action/date.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Track approvals separately so funding, signing, decisions and authorizations do not hide inside conversations.
purpose.Rule: No person is exempt from accountability tracking.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Use dashboards for the Friday Business Review and Chairman update.
purpose.Daily Input: Update by Friday close of business
purpose.Rule: Meetings end with owner, action and date.
purpose.Notes: Use Lessons Learned after delays or project completion.

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Set weekly green flags and priorities
purpose.Notes: Who? What? Where? When? How much? Proof? Next action?

purpose.How this workbook should be used: Daily updates, red flags, stage gates, docs parallel with sourcing
purpose.Primary Owner: Hybrid project method, risks/issues, DRI, escalation
purpose.Rule: Daily update, risk, action and weekly review logic absorbed
purpose.Notes: Improve tracker into practical control system

lessons.event: Sticks required for loading were not bought early enough
lessons.actual: CEO flagged that sticks should have been purchased before now instead of waiting until loading stage.
lessons.rootCause: Loading materials were not included in early readiness checklist / procurement was handled step-by-step instead of planned ahead.
lessons.impact: Potential loading delay and avoidable last-minute pressure.
lessons.control: Add loading materials checklist to pre-loading readiness plan. Required items such as sticks must be confirmed before truck arrival/loading day.

source.Root Cause: Loading materials were not included in early readiness checklist / procurement was handled step-by-step instead of planned ahead.
source.Impact: Potential loading delay and avoidable last-minute pressure.
source.Permanent Control / Prevention Rule: Add loading materials checklist to pre-loading readiness plan. Required items such as sticks must be confirmed before truck arrival/loading day.

lessons.event: Shrinkage occurred due to prolonged storage
lessons.actual: Stored goods lost weight due to moisture loss, but augmentation was done to maintain final weight.
lessons.rootCause: Storage duration was longer than expected.
lessons.impact: Additional quantity had to be added to protect final shipment weight.
lessons.control: For PRY-4C-001, reduce storage time, track weight regularly, and plan augmentation early if needed.
